question_text: Five applicants—Juan, Maria, Pedro, Ana, and Lito—are ranked based on their CSE ratings, interview scores, and years of experience. The following is known: (1) The applicant with the highest CSE rating is not the one with the most experience. (2) Maria has a higher CSE rating than Juan but lower than Pedro. (3) Ana has more experience than Lito but less than Juan. (4) The applicant with the highest interview score is Pedro, who has less experience than Ana. (5) Lito has the lowest CSE rating. If the overall ranking is determined by a composite score (CSE rating 50%, interview 30%, experience 20%), who is most likely to rank first?
